rationale: Unregistered, with v8.19.0 seed 42 as its candidate (docs/records/evals/2026-11-27-release-requirements-v19.md). Version 19 is version 18 with a new confirmation role: four collections no model has read and the IN subset below. v8.16.0 seed 42 read version 18's five collections against 11.4.0 on 2026-11-27 and failed (objective -0.0083 [-0.0143, -0.0023], postal_unit loss -0.0241 [-0.0417, -0.0064], geocode insufficient), which retires heldout-confirm-v0.8.25, heldout-confirm-v0.8.25-us, heldout-confirm-v0.8.24-in, heldout-confirm-v0.8.25-capabilities and heldout-confirm-v0.8.25-probes. Version 19's four newly drawn collections exclude every frozen collection from v0.8.0 to v0.8.25 by group and folded text: heldout-confirm-v0.8.26, 1,000 address rows in each of AU, DE, ES, FR, GB, IT and NZ (seed 2301) from the v14-confirm-b address pool; heldout-confirm-v0.8.26-us, 1,000 US rows (seed 2302) from the test split of corpus v0.8.22-retention-overlay, which holds no unread IN row; heldout-confirm-v0.8.24-in-unseen, the 632 rows of heldout-confirm-v0.8.24-in that v18's overlap audit classed verified_unseen, unchanged, because the corpus holds 14 unread IN rows, too few for the IN minimum; 11.3.0, v8.13.0 and v8.16.0 have read these rows (under v17, which passed, and v18, which failed), so section 6.5 of HOLDOUT_AND_EVALUATION retires them for recipe selection and keeps them readable for the release decision of a candidate chosen on development, as v11 and v18 used the IN rows of a read collection, and they stay unseen by v8.18.0's training: overlap.run.ts refuses v8.18.0's config for verified_unseen because its train.init_from names the v8.17.0 stage-1 checkpoint, so the audit names that stage-1 config (v8.17.0-stage1-gazetteer-v0822-s42.yaml, sha256 2fbc6cfb54c1e94c4d41d3b762d547e1692778cf8ccbc922e87b2a0fee738c39, no init_from), and both stages read only corpus v0.8.22-retention-overlay; it classes all 632 rows verified_unseen; the 14 unread rows are left out; heldout-confirm-v0.8.26-capabilities, spliced-sub-venue and spliced-country renders with seeds 2303 and 2304 filtered against every split of corpora v0.8.22-retention-overlay and v0.8.23-prominent-retention-overlay (freeze seed 2305); and heldout-confirm-v0.8.26-probes, render seed 2306, confirmation draw seed 2308. Every requirement, threshold, inference rule, statistic and the scorer revision is version 18's.

requirements.reason: Shipped en-us graph: rooftop geocoding, the demo default, postcode-us.bin and pair-index-us.bin. Exact parse of house number, street with the corpus affix split, locality, region and ZIP on three rows in five.
Shipped fr-fr overlay: rooftop geocoding over BAN and the lieu-dit pair index. Number, street, postcode and locality exact on nine rows in ten.
Shipped en-gb overlay: postcode-gb.bin, the GB pair index and county-as-region rows. Number, street, locality and postcode exact on four rows in five.
Shipped de-de overlay with the Ortsteil pair index. Street, number, PLZ and locality exact in either order on seventeen rows in twenty.
Shipped en-in overlay with the area-line pair index. Area line, locality and PIN exact on half the OSM-style rows.
Shipped es-es overlay with a pair index; tier-2 claim. Register rows exact on four in five.
Shipped it-it overlay with a pair index; tier-2 claim. Register rows exact on four in five.
Shipped en-au overlay, GNAF-trained; tier-2 claim. Register rows exact on four in five.
Shipped en-nz overlay with the LINZ pair index. Register rows exact on four in five.

requirements.task: Reading a PO Box, locked bag or CEDEX designator as one component beside an intact locality line
requirements.reason: Closed-vocabulary slot behind the former us.po_box_real and fr.cedex_real floors.
requirements.maxLossReason: A closed-vocabulary slot that moves 5 pp has lost a surface form; the country minima would absorb a loss this size.

requirements.task: Recovering a venue name and its unit designator ahead of the street line
requirements.reason: The former us.unit_real floor (n=34) on the one held-out source with a controlled unit span (1,936 rows).

requirements.task: A trailing country name tagged country rather than absorbed into the locality
requirements.reason: The former us.country_homograph_f1 floor (n=54) protected the country slot; the homograph confound stays a diagnostic.

requirements.task: Reading a flat, unit, floor, staircase or building designator with its identifier as one unit component, in the line position the postal operator's guideline gives it
requirements.reason: Issue #2764: cited operator rules for FR (SP 8855 lines 2 and 3), GB (PAF Sub Building Name), IT (scala, piano, interno on line 3), AU (FLAT/UNIT TYPE table) and NZ (ADV358 Unit Type), with only designators no training recipe draws. A row whose expected spans hold a venue is left out: the FR named complexes (RESIDENCE, LOTISSEMENT), labeled venue since recipe fix 48fca721dd, carry no unit span, so they don't test this task.
requirements.maxLossReason: The operator decided on 2026-11-18 that a release mustn't lose this capability against the published model, which reads it below any registered minimum: no training recipe draws these designators, so the rate a candidate reaches measures the corpus, and the release decides only whether the change loses it. No loss is the objective's own threshold (minimumImprovement 0), so an arm whose difference interval reaches below zero reads insufficient evidence, as the objective does.

requirements.task: Resolving an ordinary address to the components and admin places its answer key gives, on the geocode path production runs
requirements.reason: A change that acts only in the resolver, such as countyDesignatorFallback, leaves every exact-parse outcome equal, so no other check can judge it (lane Y, docs/records/evals/2026-11-17-county-fallback-and-arabic-fold.md). The outcome is heldout/per/geocode-outcome's: the resolved components and every written locality, dependent locality, subregion, region and country placed at its tag.
requirements.maxLossReason: The objective admits no exact-parse loss in the equal-country rate (minimumImprovement 0). The geocode outcome is bounded at one point of the same equal-country rate. A model change reads the comparative rows, so the bound inherits the objective's width; a resolver change, with one model in both arms, reads every recorded class and its bound decides at one point.

inference.description: HELDOUT_INFERENCE_RULE in heldout/per/country.ts (served-locale-package): each row is parsed by the shipped Latin locale package for its country (release.config.json locales), falling back to en-us, with the row's country as localeHint; a package whose loader reports an unfed required channel is refused. The verdict records the rule and the rows each package parsed.

statistics.groupingAssumption: A row's independent unit is its group within its country: base_source_id when derived, else source_id. Rows are not declared independent, so a check that reads an ungrouped row is insufficient evidence. Limitation: structure shared across groups (one source's conventions, one place's many addresses) is not modelled. The dataset quota counts groups, not rows, against 1,000 per country.

development.description: v13's development collections, unchanged: heldout-dev-v0.8.18 v4, heldout-dev-v0.8.19-probes-r2 v2 and heldout-dev-v0.8.21, with the paths and sha256 values v13 records. evaluation-groups.v0.8.21.json sent every group of the three to test in corpus v0.8.21-retention-overlay, the corpus 11.2.0 trained on, and evaluation-groups.v0.8.22.json keeps them in test and adds the NAD address key of every frozen NAD row (#3125). 11.2.0 trained on the US rows of heldout-dev-v0.8.21 that a re-ingested NAD record repeats, so those rows stay known_overlap for every comparison against it; the record gives the counts. Used for recipe, checkpoint and seed selection.

confirmation.description: Rows that neither 11.4.0 nor a candidate on corpus v0.8.22-retention-overlay or v0.8.23-prominent-retention-overlay trains on, unread except heldout-confirm-v0.8.24-in-unseen. heldout-confirm-v0.8.26 holds 1,000 address rows in each of AU, DE, ES, FR, GB, IT and NZ (seed 2301) from rows outside every corpus split; heldout-confirm-v0.8.26-us 1,000 US rows (seed 2302) from v0.8.22-retention-overlay's test groups outside every frozen collection; heldout-confirm-v0.8.24-in-unseen the 632 verified_unseen IN rows of heldout-confirm-v0.8.24-in, which 11.3.0, v8.13.0 and v8.16.0 have read, read only for the IN strata of a candidate chosen on development; heldout-confirm-v0.8.26-capabilities 600 rows per country of spliced-sub-venue and spliced-country renders (seeds 2303 and 2304, freeze seed 2305); heldout-confirm-v0.8.26-probes 5,000 rows (render seed 2306, confirmation draw seed 2308). The overlap audit against both corpora with folded text and address keys classes each row. Read once, for the release decision; every read is recorded in the next spec version's rationale.
